arguments.query:
WITH d AS (
 SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(order_purchase_time) AS purchased,
 MIN(effective_delivery_time) AS actual, MIN(promised_delivery_time) AS promised
 FROM semantic.order_delivery_evidence_v1
 WHERE order_purchase_time >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND order_purchase_time < DATE '2018-04-01' GROUP BY order_id
), r AS (
 SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(purchase_time) AS purchased,
 MIN(order_score) AS score, MAX(review_records) AS records
 FROM semantic.order_review_evidence_v1 GROUP BY order_id
), joined AS (
 SELECT d.*, r.n AS rn, r.purchased AS rpurchased, r.score, r.records,
 CASE WHEN actual IS NULL OR promised IS NULL THEN 'unclassified'
 WHEN actual > promised THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS cohort
 FROM d LEFT JOIN r ON d.order_id=r.order_id
), grouped AS (
 SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(score) AS reviewed,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score <= 2) AS low,
 COALESCE(SUM(score),0) AS score_sum,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE records > 1) AS multi_review_orders
 FROM joined GROUP BY cohort
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined) AS total,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined WHERE n <> 1 OR rn > 1 OR order_id IS NULL) AS invalid_grain,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined WHERE rn IS NOT NULL AND purchased IS DISTINCT FROM rpurchased) AS misaligned,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined WHERE score < 1 OR score > 5) AS invalid_scores,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM joined WHERE rn IS NULL) AS missing_review_rows,
 COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(grouped)) FROM grouped),'[]'::jsonb) AS cohorts

arguments.query:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS eligible_orders,
COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::bigint AS distinct_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lateness_eligible)::bigint AS lateness_eligible_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late IS TRUE)::bigint AS late_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE duration_eligible)::bigint AS duration_eligible_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE effective_delivery_time IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_actual,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE promised_delivery_time IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_estimated,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_time IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_purchase,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE duration_eligible AND (delivery_days IS NULL OR delivery_days < 0))::bigint AS invalid_duration,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (lateness_eligible IS DISTINCT FROM (effective_delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND promised_delivery_time IS NOT NULL)) OR (lateness_eligible AND is_late IS DISTINCT FROM (effective_delivery_time > promised_delivery_time)) OR (NOT lateness_eligible AND is_late IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS invalid_late_flags,
AVG(delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE duration_eligible) AS mean_delivery_days,
(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late IS TRUE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lateness_eligible),0)) AS late_rate_pct,
(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lateness_eligible) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)) AS lateness_coverage_pct
FROM semantic.order_delivery_evidence_v1
WHERE order_purchase_time >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND order_purchase_time < DATE '2018-04-01'

limitations: Purchase-time cohorts; not delivery-completion cohorts
Actual delivery dates may include modeled incident adjustments
Orders missing delivery timestamps are excluded from lateness denominator
Nonempty period is not certification of continuous coverage
Descriptive; no causal inference

arguments.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS placed, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS placed_distinct,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_items,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT i.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS without_items,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS represented,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.order_id IS NOT NULL AND e.order_id IS NULL) AS item_missing_finance,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT i.order_id IS NOT NULL AND e.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS finance_missing_item,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.order_id IS NULL AND o.order_status='canceled') AS canceled_missing,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.order_id IS NULL AND o.order_status='unavailable') AS unavailable_missing,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.order_id IS NULL AND o.order_status='created') AS created_missing,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.order_id IS NULL AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable','created')) AS other_missing,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE e.order_id IS NULL AND o.order_status IS NULL) AS null_status_missing
       FROM "commerce"."orders" o
       LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM "commerce"."order_items") i ON i.order_id=o.order_id
       LEFT JOIN "semantic"."order_economics" e ON e.order_id=o.order_id
       WHERE (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) < DATE '2018-03-01' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT e.order_id) AS unique_orders,
      SUM(e.effective_revenue) AS revenue, SUM(e.effective_cogs) AS cogs,
      SUM(e.effective_contribution_profit) AS profit
      FROM "semantic"."order_economics" e WHERE (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(e."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(e."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(e."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(e."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) < DATE '2018-03-01' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(d.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(d.cogs) AS cogs,
      SUM(d.contribution_profit) AS profit, SUM(d.orders) AS orders
      FROM "semantic"."daily_commerce" d WHERE (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(d."business_date"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(d."business_date"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(d."business_date"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(d."business_date"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) < DATE '2018-03-01' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS financial_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.order_id IS NULL) AS finance_only,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT ((CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND (CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), ''), 'timestamp without time zone') THEN NULLIF(BTRIM(o."order_purchase_timestamp"::text), '')::timestamp ELSE NULL END) < DATE '2018-03-01')) AS period_mismatch,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE i.order_id IS NULL) AS no_items
      FROM "semantic"."order_economics" e
      LEFT JOIN "commerce"."orders" o ON o.order_id=e.order_id
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM "commerce"."order_items") i ON i.order_id=e.order_id

SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS eligible_orders,
COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::bigint AS distinct_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lateness_eligible)::bigint AS lateness_eligible_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late IS TRUE)::bigint AS late_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE duration_eligible)::bigint AS duration_eligible_orders,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE effective_delivery_time IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_actual,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE promised_delivery_time IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_estimated,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_purchase_time IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_purchase,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE duration_eligible AND (delivery_days IS NULL OR delivery_days < 0))::bigint AS invalid_duration,
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (lateness_eligible IS DISTINCT FROM (effective_delivery_time IS NOT NULL AND promised_delivery_time IS NOT NULL)) OR (lateness_eligible AND is_late IS DISTINCT FROM (effective_delivery_time > promised_delivery_time)) OR (NOT lateness_eligible AND is_late IS NOT NULL))::bigint AS invalid_late_flags,
AVG(delivery_days) FILTER (WHERE duration_eligible) AS mean_delivery_days,
(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late IS TRUE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lateness_eligible),0)) AS late_rate_pct,
(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lateness_eligible) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)) AS lateness_coverage_pct
FROM semantic.order_delivery_evidence_v1
WHERE order_purchase_time >= DATE '2016-12-01' AND order_purchase_time < DATE '2017-01-01'
